entities.summary: Anna Louise Christine "Lone" Maslocha, also Masłocha, née Mogensen was a Polish-born Danish photographer who became a resistance fighter during the German occupation of Denmark in World War II. She was associated with the Polish-English intelligence service and with the Danish resistance movement Holger Danske and worked for the prominent Danish resistance member Citronen. Lone Mogensen was a painters & sculptors from Klucze, Lesser Poland Voivodeship (1921-10-26, Klucze, Lesser Poland Voivodeship–1945-01-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
